courses.name: B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering
courses.summary: A four-year undergraduate engineering degree covering structural analysis and design, geotechnical engineering, transportation engineering, water resources, environmental engineering, surveying and construction management. Programmes pair lecture teaching with materials, hydraulics and surveying laboratories, site visits and a final-year design project. Graduates work in construction, infrastructure, consultancy and public works, or continue to a master's specialisation.

courses.summary: A four-year undergraduate engineering degree covering engineering mechanics, thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, heat transfer, machine design, manufacturing processes and control systems. Teaching is built around workshop practice, thermal and materials laboratories, computer-aided design and a final-year project. Graduates move into manufacturing, automotive, energy, thermal and design roles, or continue to a master's specialisation such as thermal engineering or machine design.

Study covers advanced programming, algorithms, database management, software engineering, computer networks and web technologies, with electives such as machine learning, cloud computing, data analytics and cyber security, and usually a major project or industry internship. Graduates typically work as software developers, systems analysts or IT consultants, and some continue to doctoral research in computer applications.

courses.summary: The B.E./B.Tech in Biotechnology is an undergraduate engineering degree that applies engineering principles to living systems. Students study biochemistry, microbiology, molecular biology and genetic engineering alongside bioprocess engineering, fermentation technology, downstream processing, bioinformatics and engineering mathematics, with substantial laboratory work and an industry or research project. It is usually a four-year programme entered after secondary school with physics, chemistry and mathematics or biology. Graduates work in biopharmaceutical, food, agricultural and environmental biotechnology or continue to M.Tech or research study.

courses.summary: The M.E./M.Tech in Energy Engineering is a postgraduate engineering degree in producing, converting, storing and managing energy. Coursework typically covers thermodynamics and heat transfer, solar, wind and bioenergy systems, energy storage and batteries, power systems and grid integration, energy efficiency and auditing, and energy policy, followed by a research dissertation. It suits graduates in mechanical, electrical or chemical engineering or the physical sciences. The degree normally lasts two years and leads to roles in renewable-energy development, utilities and energy consultancy, or to research.

Advanced study covers water and wastewater treatment design, air-quality management, solid and hazardous waste engineering, environmental modelling, impact and risk assessment, and health and safety management, with a research dissertation in the final year. The degree normally lasts two years and leads to roles in environmental consultancy, pollution-control agencies, utilities and industry, or to doctoral research.

universities.summary: Periyar Maniammai Institute of Science & Technology (PMIST) is a private deemed-to-be university at Vallam, Thanjavur, Tamil Nadu. Its regular degree portfolio spans engineering, computing, management, architecture, science and humanities. Engineering, MBA and MCA entry routes combine programme-specific academic requirements with merit or entrance selection.
universities.campusLifestyle: The Vallam campus covers 114.85 acres. Students can use sports facilities and participate in the National Sports Organization’s physical-fitness, martial-arts, games and sports activities. Periyar Maniammai Hospital operates inside the campus.
universities.cityProfile: PMIST is at Periyar Nagar, Vallam, Thanjavur, Tamil Nadu 613403. Its teaching campus is distinct from Periyar University in Salem and from Ponnaiyah Ramajayam Institute of Science & Technology (PRIST), another Thanjavur institution. The university’s online registration route serves applicants to the Vallam campus.
universities.practicalExposure: The postgraduate regulations provide credit-bearing industrial training or internships in two-week slots: two weeks earn one credit, four weeks two credits and six weeks three credits. A continuous placement within one organization and a submitted report form part of the assessment. Up to six weeks of summer industrial training can replace one professional elective under the specified approval process. The Centre for University Industry Interaction coordinates placement, training and university-industry activity.
universities.hostelOverview: Campus accommodation includes Chakravarthy boys’ hostel and Annai Maniammaiyar and Vittobai girls’ hostels. Published accommodation charges include room rent, mess, electricity and maintenance, washing and deposits. The available fee PDF is undated, so obtain the current room allocation and total payable amount before budgeting.
universities.dietarySupport: Hostel mess charges are listed separately from room rent and include meals within the accommodation fee structure. The available schedule does not establish current menus or special-diet provision; discuss dietary requirements before choosing accommodation.
universities.safetyOverview: The campus has an Anti-Ragging Cell, an Internal Complaints Committee and a student grievance process. The on-campus hospital operates 24 hours with a medical officer and paramedical support.
universities.studentSupport: The Centre for Student Administrative Services handles student grievances, including admission, fee-refund and accommodation concerns. An International Academic Advisor supports international students with programme and campus information. Students Traffic can help review programme fit and application readiness.

faq.question: Is PMIST private or government?
faq.answer: PMIST is a private deemed-to-be university. The UGC register records its deemed status from 17 August 2007 and locates it at Vallam, Thanjavur.

faq.question: Is PMIST the same as Periyar University?
faq.answer: No. PMIST is at Vallam in Thanjavur. Periyar University is a separate state university in Salem, while PRIST is another distinct institution in Thanjavur.

faq.question: What is the teaching language?
faq.answer: Established B.Tech routes have programme-specific English evidence. Posted 2024 undergraduate and postgraduate regulations generally prescribe English, with Tamil for Tamil programmes and stated bilingual arrangements. Newer engineering variants without specific evidence show no language; confirm the exact programme arrangement.

faq.question: Can international applicants apply?
faq.answer: The 2026-27 approval identifies international access programme by programme. Some programmes have international approval while others do not; a university-wide international policy should not be used to assume access to every degree.

faq.question: What subjects are needed for B.Tech?
faq.answer: Aerospace, Civil and Mechanical Engineering require Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics. Biotechnology requires Physics and Chemistry with Biology, Biotechnology or Mathematics; CSE, ECE and EEE require Physics and Mathematics plus an approved additional subject.

faq.question: What is the MBA entry requirement?
faq.answer: Applicants need a bachelor’s degree of at least three years with 50% marks, or 45% for a reserved category. A qualifying PMIST, TANCET, MAT, CAT or equivalent entrance result is required for the dual-specialisation MBA.

faq.question: How do students apply?
faq.answer: Use PMIST’s online registration page and select the intended programme. Complete the academic details, follow the relevant merit or entrance route and present the required qualification and admission-category records.

faq.question: When does the academic year begin?
faq.answer: The signed schedule gives 22 July 2026 for the verified 2026–27 cycle on the established routes. This is not a future intake or application deadline. New entries without an exact first-entry month leave that field blank; follow the applicable programme notice.

faq.question: How much should students budget?
faq.answer: Request a current, category-specific quotation covering tuition, compulsory charges, accommodation and meals. The public programme-fee table gives total first-year charges without a clear academic year or tuition-only breakdown, so it is not used as a confirmed tuition price.

faq.question: Does PMIST have hostels?
faq.answer: Chakravarthy boys’ hostel and the girls’ hostels provide campus accommodation. Charges include room rent, mess and other service components; confirm current availability, deposits and fees before accepting a room.

faq.question: Is practical training part of postgraduate study?
faq.answer: The postgraduate regulations provide credit for industrial training and internships in two-week slots. Students complete continuous training in an organization, submit a report and follow departmental evaluation and approval requirements.
